description: This file defines a custom XML/HTML tree builder implementation using an ElementTree-like interface, including classes for elements, comments, document types, and document fragments, as well as serialization functions.

classes.name: Element
classes.description: Represents an XML/HTML element with methods for attribute and child node management.

classes.name: Comment
classes.description: Represents an XML comment node, subclass of Element.

classes.name: DocumentType
classes.description: Represents a document type declaration with public and system IDs.

classes.name: TreeBuilder
classes.description: Main class for building and serializing the document tree, configurable with different ElementTree implementations.

methods.name: getETreeBuilder
methods.description: Factory function that creates a tree builder class with custom element classes and serialization logic.

methods.name: testSerializer
methods.description: Function to serialize an element to a string for testing purposes.

methods.name: tostring
methods.description: Serializes an element and its children to a string.
